embedding_metadata_note: The legacy field usage.decision_item_sha256 hashes [item_id,option_order_id], not the full item. All 28 identity-pair hashes, actual producer query strings, selected query/chunk hashes and vector response indices were verified; no artifacts were rewritten.
limitations: Seven semantic comparisons per researcher; order reversals are coupled. Neel has two source groups and Chris one.
Intervals are descriptive source-group bootstrap intervals (2000 draws, seed 0); two observed groups cannot establish generalization. One group gives no interval.
P1 remains a prior pilot build failure with zero coverage on its original eight ordered outcomes; it is not a full-panel prediction arm.
Public atemporal source judgments can be known from pretraining or generic wording. Single evaluator; no independent annotation agreement.
API cost is a conservative uncached list-price estimate, not an invoice.
No finalist selection, confirmation evidence or downstream research utility claim.
Two one-time embedding production requests are separate from 28 semantic predictions; their cost is not repeated per built profile.
scoring_reuse: The four existing control arm scores and comparisons are reused unchanged from saved reports; only new semantic predictions were scored.
